title: One retained chord affine-query kernel with requested-policy decisions and complete rotated carrier dispatch
decision: Retain the higher-priority requested-policy and affine-query completeness fixes despite the recorded mixed timing costs. Remove the duplicated private map predicates without compatibility shims; do not claim uniform speed or release readiness.

source.public_api: Unchanged. Six old private map-query methods and four now-unused arithmetic/query helpers removed. One private affine authority; no compatibility alias, cache, object field, or retained representation added.
source.behavior: Sign a.P+b.C+offset in the existing retained field. Derived queries pull coefficients through C+r(P-C)+sJ(P-C)+T before field arithmetic. Caller policy controls decisions after provenance validation; strict replay stays strict. Recursive projective denominators remain positive; dense signed quotients sign N*D. Same-source equality also handles distinct rotated transforms that denote the same point.

regressions.exact_oracles: Closed-form P=(1,0), C=(0,0) transformed coordinates, exact equality and separated signs; distinct-transform cancellation; exact y=-1 recursive line controls; unchanged certified interval bounds rounded outward to rational dyadics bracket 2x-3y under three signed/radial/rotated transforms for every carrier family.
regressions.requested_policy: Initial controls separately reproduce two requested-policy failures before stronger oracle additions. Repeated STRICT, APPROXIMATE_512 and forced-strict subpasses verify classification and certainty without cache poisoning.
regressions.original_failures: Six of eight final controls fail: the broader oracle exposes original unsupported rotated dispatch in axis, oblique and selected-radial carriers as well as recursive unrotated queries. The fallback control stops at its first oblique failure; later original branches are not claimed individually executed. Both final test modules are byte-identical.
regressions.prior_epochs: Initial candidate passed all 919 library tests including opt-in tests. The first expanded oracle epoch failed where recursive transformed bounds were unavailable and a chosen represented constructor was unsupported; those test-harness limitations are preserved. Explicit supported fallback constructors and a proven represented fixture provide all seven final carrier guards. No production bounds path was added or relaxed.

validation.scope: Seven archived repositories without live dependency symlinks. Both revisions use the same archived Hypercurve path; concurrent Hyperreal drafts excluded and untouched. Minimal opt-in cases are covered by the full all-feature run.

control.profile_workloads: Only the two final guards which complete in both versions are profiled. Early unsupported results are not performance controls. Executable names control-test and changed-test have equal length.

memory.scope: Single complete whole-libtest Heaptrack format-3 streams, not geometry-only attribution, ecosystem memory coverage, RSS causality or leak proof. Final live allocation counts reconcile; compressed streams pass zstd integrity checks.

instructions.scope: Whole-libtest Callgrind; every summary equals total. Instrumented durations are not latency measurements.

binary_size.scope: Matched source paths and build profiles. Raw section tables and frozen binaries retained.

timing.scope: Prespecified three alternating CPU-7 pairs and seven additional native pairs, after owned builds and profiles finished. All lanes retained; no retry or favorable subrange selection. Within-binary whole-process max/min guard 1.5 is reported, not a proof of host stability. Scheduling, desktop activity, frequency scaling and thermal state uncontrolled; no uniform performance claim.

events: The /tmp user quota prevented sandbox setup and earlier builds; it later also blocked the sandboxed patch helper. Approved host execution used this workspace-local target and TMPDIR, with the same apply_patch mechanism for edits.

Only the prior rational-equality experiment's completed Cargo build cache was cleaned with approval: 14,665 files, 5.2 GiB. All 3,694 prior manifest entries were verified outside that cache. Rebuilding regenerates the cache; sources, frozen binaries and raw proof remain.

artifacts.scope: Frozen sources, archived dependencies, scripts, catalogs, binaries and all experiment/qualification/measurement logs. Rebuildable cache and temporary files excluded.

milestones.next: Diagnose the preserved recursive transformed-bounds failures in FOLLOWUPS.md. Continue non-angular retained-policy and single-authority CurveRegion2 audits; remove the one-item coarse-sign loop separately without bypassing exact-fiber fallback. Requalify finalized lower-stack work with Hypermesh.
